name: Stamp text
summary: A rubber-stamp word in a rough box that slams down at an angle with ink speckle, for APPROVED, VOID or SOLD marks.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks to fit 860 px

params.name: seed
params.note: change to get a different ink pattern
